description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R scores for different large language models (LLMs) under varying conditions of self-fine-tuning (SFT). The horizontal axis represents the LLM, with categories labeled “LLaMA-2-7B”, “LLaMA-2-13B”, and “LLaMA-2-70B” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents the CoLeG-R score, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, and tick marks at 10-unit intervals.  Four bars are present for each LLM category, representing different SFT conditions: “no SFT” (light blue), “+ SFT on D₀” (orange), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (pink), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (red). For LLaMA-2-7B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 65, “+ SFT on D₀” reaches approximately 72, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” reaches approximately 78, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” reaches approximately 79. For LLaMA-2-13B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 68, “+ SFT on D₀” reaches approximately 75, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” reaches approximately 80, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” reaches approximately 81. For LLaMA-2-70B, the “no SFT” bar reaches approximately 64, “+ SFT on D₀” reaches approximately 73, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” reaches approximately 79, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” reaches approximately 80. The bars are grouped by LLM, with each group containing one bar for each SFT condition. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
